verdict_reason: The move to the IntegrationBase request helpers keeps every scoping assertion intact, but two test titles claim more than their assertions prove (persists nothing; byte-identical 404s).

todos.issue: missingOrgHeaderOnPostIsAPlatformAuthRejection400AndPersistsNothing (:68) proves 'persists nothing' only with activeAddressesFor(ORG_A).isEmpty(). A POST with no Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id header has no organisation to stamp, so any address it did persist would not be under ORG_A: the persistence half of the title cannot fail.
todos.fix: Must: the test fails if a POST without the org header stores any document. One way: assert the addresses collection holds no documents (e.g. mongoTemplate.count(new Query(), Address.class) == 0, which the per-test cleanDatabase makes exact), or drop 'AndPersistsNothing' from the title.

todos.issue: a404ForAnotherOrgsLiveAddressIsByteIdenticalToA404ForAnUnknownId (:92) claims byte-identical bodies, but problemBody (:104) parses each into a Map and the test compares the maps (:98), so differences in key order, whitespace or number formatting would pass. The title says more than the assertion proves.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertion proves. One way: compare crossOrg.getResponse().getContentAsString() with unknown's for a real byte-level check, or rename to a404ForAnotherOrgsLiveAddressHasTheSameProblemBodyAsA404ForAnUnknownId.
